source.description: A reviewed six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet showing one consistent suspension bridge progressing from pale perspective construction to a restrained graphite and colored-pencil finish.
source.notes: Keep one low three-quarter bridge view with two rectangular towers, one deck narrowing toward a right-side vanishing point, two main cable arcs, a consistent rhythm of visible vertical suspender lines, two anchor points, a distant shoreline, calm water bands, and one broken reflection stable. No named bridge, skyline, cars, people, signs, lettering, labels, arrows, numbers, signature, watermark, or final-only structure.

process_strategy: Lock the horizon, deck wedge, two tower boxes, cable arcs, anchors, shoreline, and water footprint in pale construction; build every structural contour and the full suspender rhythm before shading; then add only restrained graphite, rust-red pencil, blue-gray water, and paper highlights to the established bridge.

final_elements.name: horizon, vanishing point, deck wedge, tower boxes, cable arcs, shoreline, and reflection guides
final_elements.description: Pale graphite construction fixes one low three-quarter view, a deck narrowing to the right, two tower placements, two main cable arcs, a distant shore, calm water, and a broken reflection footprint.

final_elements.name: two complete bridge towers, receding deck, rail edges, and two anchor points
final_elements.description: Two rectangular portal towers and one tapered deck establish the bridge silhouette, with both rail edges and cable anchors aligned to the same perspective.

final_elements.name: two main suspension cables and a consistent rhythm of vertical suspenders
final_elements.description: Two smooth cable arcs connect the tower tops and anchors, while a clear sequence of vertical lines ties the established cables to the deck.

final_elements.name: tower crossbars, deck seams, shoreline shapes, calm water bands, and broken reflection
final_elements.description: Simple structural crossbars and deck seams clarify the bridge while a low shoreline, broad water bands, and a broken reflection complete the setting.

final_elements.name: graphite structure values, rust-red bridge color, blue-gray water, and open paper highlights
final_elements.description: Directional graphite and restrained colored pencil separate the bridge, distance, water, and reflection without hiding the handmade construction.

restrained rust-red and blue-gray colored-pencil layering

rejection_checks: The same low three-quarter bridge, two towers, deck taper, cable routes, anchors, shoreline, water crop, and reflection footprint must persist through all six panels.
Exactly two tower portals, two main cable arcs, two anchors, and the established vertical suspender rhythm must appear before the final panel and persist.
No named landmark, skyline, car, person, boat, sign, word, label, arrow, number, signature, watermark, or final-only structure may appear.

The finish must retain visible graphite and colored-pencil grain rather than polished architectural rendering or vector-like linework, and every dark pre-final line must survive unless it is a pale erasable guide.
